ideas.idea: Broken image: /img/reception.jpg missing and no passthrough copy for images; add file and passthrough
ideas.why: No src/img exists and .eleventy.js copies only robots.txt and sitemap.xml, so the home image likely 404s.

ideas.idea: Add width and height attributes to the image
ideas.why: Standard layout-shift advice that applies to any site and has little effect here.

ideas.idea: Make layout omit meta description tag when description is unset
ideas.why: base.njk renders an empty content attribute for pages like /team, so a conditional is a concrete layout fix.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter tags to layout
ideas.why: This is standard social-sharing markup that has little effect on search or AI understanding.

ideas.idea: Replace vague claims (thousands of patients, decades of experience, simple prices) with concrete facts such as named dentists, qualifications, prices and year established
ideas.why: The quoted claims are in the files and are vague, so specifics would give people and machines something to cite.

ideas.idea: Add Dentist/LocalBusiness and WebSite JSON-LD site-wide in the layout
ideas.why: Structured data exists only on /contact, so putting it in the layout is specific and plausible.

ideas.idea: Add Person/Physician markup on /team and Service/MedicalProcedure markup on /services
ideas.why: These pages have no structured data and the markup matches their content.

ideas.idea: Add FAQPage markup if Q&A content is added
ideas.why: FAQ markup is folklore here, since the site has no Q&A content and FAQs are not required.

ideas.idea: Add address, openingHours, url, image and sameAs to the contact JSON-LD
ideas.why: The existing Dentist block has only a name and telephone, and the address 12 Park Row, Leeds is on the page.

ideas.idea: Reconsider data-nosnippet on the insurance terms, or remove it
ideas.why: The scoped data-nosnippet is a deliberate choice, and the report asks to reverse it.
A four-page flat site gains almost nothing from breadcrumbs.

ideas.idea: Add a footer with address, phone and opening hours (NAP) on every page
ideas.why: The layout has no footer, and the contact details appear only on /contact.

ideas.idea: Add explicit robots.txt groups for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended
ideas.why: User-agent: * with Allow: / already allows them, so named groups change nothing.

ideas.idea: Generate sitemap from Eleventy collections with lastmod
ideas.why: A four-URL static sitemap is accurate, and lastmod and generation add little.

ideas.idea: Add a 404 page and a favicon
ideas.why: This is standard hygiene that applies to nearly any site.
The report calls it cheap to add, but the brief says having none is fine and llms.txt does not help a site get found.

ideas.idea: Add nofollow to /thanks and use 'noindex, follow' in the layout
ideas.why: It contradicts itself and fiddles with a deliberate noindex that is already correct.

ideas.idea: Add 'Leeds' to the contact page title
ideas.why: The title 'Contact' has no location while the page is the local NAP page, so adding it is a small, specific improvement.

ideas.idea: Put the origin in src/_data/site.json and use it everywhere
ideas.why: The origin is hardcoded in several places, and a single data file would prevent the staging-host mistake.
